_comment: Single source of truth for all configurable parameters in spec.md. Roles read this; nothing re-derives these values independently. See harness spec.md Generation Rules for this requirement.

rounds._note: one round timer for the whole game; every round advances import-open, export-close, and winner-resolution in lockstep (spec #9-#12)

imports._note: spec #14, #22 -- same category may go to different cities but not to the same city twice, by default

economy._note: spec #20-#22 -- exposure policy is intentionally config-driven so it can be iterated on; non-winning submission origin must never be exposed regardless of this config (spec #21, not overridable)

facilitator_questions._note: spec #23-#25; scope is configurable for a future domain-specific harness run (e.g. 'coding_preferences')

newspaper._note: spec #26-#30; player_identity_style may later support more anonymity per decisions Q26

roles._note: Generator gets the more creative-leaning model (game content, newspaper prose, city descriptions/images are the bulk of its work). Evaluator gets a model tuned for strict, literal rule-checking against spec.md. Both invoked via `claude --model <alias>`. Revisit if either role's output quality suggests a swap.
